run_style_mixing_cli: run the style mixing CLI to generate a style-mixed image matrix from a pretrained StyleGAN2 network pickle
generate_style_mix_images: generate style-mixed images by blending W vectors from different random seeds across specified style layers
parse_num_range: parse a comma-separated list or hyphenated range string into a list of integers for seed or style layer arguments
review_generate_style_mix: review the generate_style_mix function to understand how W vectors are truncated and blended across row and column seeds
refactor_style_mixing_output: refactor the style mixing script to support custom output formats or additional image grid layouts
